messages:
Nina (AE): Heads-up: New POC ask from Northbound. They want a short 2-week technical trial focusing on 3 prioritized workflows: triage classification, automated summarization for notes, and tone-normalization for customer replies. Need a compact prompt inventory and baseline evals. Can we scope by EOD? @Ravi @Dmitri
Ravi (SE): Yep. Quick clarification: are we doing hosted only? Their legal raised questions about encryption-at-rest keys. Assume hosted but prepare for Dedicated ask.
Nina (AE): Hosted preferred but they'll want KMS and SSO info. Sales flagged potential dedicated if KMS requirement can't be met.
Dmitri (PM): Draft success criteria proposal: classification F1 >= 0.75, summary BLEU/ROUGE-ish target ROUGE-L >= 0.58, tone-normalization judged 80% acceptable on a 200-sample blind review, p95 latency < 600ms, and <5% critical safety flags. Thoughts?
Clara (Solutions Eng): Reasonable. For evaluation we should ship 150 labeled examples per flow (total 450) to keep turnaround quick. I can wire up the eval harness. Example run: `python eval/run.py --suite northbound_baseline --n 150 --model redwood-hosted-v1`
Ravi (SE): Prompt inventory — initial pass (short + instrumented):
1) classification_prompt_v1: "Label the user's intent from the following options: [payment_issue, feature_request, account_update, other]. Return only the label."
2) summarization_prompt_v1: "Summarize the conversation in 3 bullets focusing on actions and outcomes."
3) tone_normalize_v1: "Rewrite the user-visible reply to be professional, concise, and empathetic. Keep <120 chars."
4) safety_guard_v1: "If user content violates policy, output 'BLOCK' and a one-line reason; otherwise proceed."
Ravi (SE): Each prompt will include 15 golden examples for quick spot-checks and an expected metric (accuracy/F1/ROUGE/manual_agreement).
Dmitri (PM): Action items: 1) SEs (Ravi/Clara) to publish prompt JSON + gold sets by tomorrow morning. 2) Solutions Eng (Clara) to provide eval scripts + run instructions. 3) AE (Nina) to collect any additional customer examples and confirm timeline. 4) Ops-bot to run a perf test (canary) day before POC start.
Nina (AE): I provided them with a usage estimate: baseline qps 1.5, peak 8, avg tokens 250. Use that for a hosted cost estimate; Steve in sales ops will handle detailed pricing.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Security: I'll take the questionnaire. Flag: they asked about data deletion timelines and audit logs. We'll propose hosted data retention policy (30 days for POC logs) and confirm KMS options; escalate Dedicated if required.
ops-bot: perftest: eval-harness-canary build 0.3.1 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Ravi (SE): I'll keep the prompt set minimal at first and add instrumentation for token counts, latency per prompt, and confidence signal in the response.
Dmitri (PM): Timeline: kickoff next Tues; 2-week window. Midpoint review end of week 1 to assess blockers. Final review W+2 Friday for go/no-go.
Nina (AE): Great. If SEs can deliver the prompts + gold sets tomorrow, I can present the scope to the customer on Thurs and lock dates.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Will upload to POC Google Drive and paste link. Also will include a quick `README.md` with how to run evals and parse reports.
Dmitri (PM): I'll add acceptance checklist to POC runbook: owner, metric thresholds, sample size, handoff notes.
Nina (AE): Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with any security or infra blockers.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Sharing initial prompt JSON now in drive link: https://drive.redwood.example/northbound/prompt-set (pseudo-link).
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: mid-poc-checkpoint in 7 days.
Nina (AE): Closing for now.
